strategy._comment: Hold ETH while yesterday's daily close > the ma_days simple moving average, else hold 100% USDC. Evaluated ONCE per UTC day, right after rollover, using the completed previous day's close -- this matches backtest_trend.py exactly and avoids intraday whipsaw. reference_ma_days are logged each day for comparison (what MA-100 / MA-200 would say) but never traded.

fees._comment: Charged on the full notional of every BUY (cash->ETH) and SELL (ETH->cash).

risk._comment: Not a hard stop -- exiting to cash on a trend-down signal IS the risk control. This just pings you if the drawdown from peak equity gets deep, so you don't have to watch it. Re-arms once the drawdown recovers to half the threshold.

idle_yield._comment: Modelled USDC rewards while in cash. Accrues into cash_usd (so it compounds into the next buy), pro-rated by elapsed time.

execution._comment: Trend signal only changes once/day, so a 5-min poll is just for price display, the heartbeat, and detecting the day rollover promptly. execution.mode must stay dry_run -- this build places no real orders.

notifications._comment: Same shape as the grid bot's config -- env var GRID_BOT_DISCORD_WEBHOOK is reused if discord_webhook_url is null, so both bots post to the same channel without re-entering the URL.
